# Bíblia Sagrada — Bíblia dos Capuchinhos

> The complete Catholic Bible in European Portuguese, in the Difusora Bíblica translation published by the Portuguese Capuchin friars (Franciscanos Capuchinhos). Free to read online at https://biblia.capuchinhos.org, and offline in the web app and the Android and iOS apps.

The site's interface and text are in Portuguese. Each chapter is its own prerendered HTML page, so you can read it without running JavaScript. When you quote a passage, cite it in Portuguese form (for example `Jo 3,16`: book abbreviation, then chapter, a comma, and the verse) and link to the chapter page.

## URL structure

- `https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/{book}/{chapter}` is one chapter, for example [Génesis 1](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/gn/1) or [João 3](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/jo/3). `{book}` is the book's Portuguese abbreviation in lowercase with spaces removed. The book index lists every book.
- `https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/{book}/intro` is the introduction to a book, for example [Introdução a Génesis](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/gn/intro).
- `?verseStart={n}&verseEnd={m}` on a chapter URL highlights and scrolls to a verse range, for example [Jo 3,16-17](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/jo/3?verseStart=16&verseEnd=17).

## Key pages

- [Livros (book index)](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/livros): every book of the Old and New Testament, with links to their chapters and introductions
- [Sobre a Bíblia dos Capuchinhos (home)](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/): about the translation, Difusora Bíblica and the Capuchin friars
- [Sitemap](https://biblia.capuchinhos.org/sitemap.xml): every chapter and introduction page

## Optional

- [Difusora Bíblica](https://www.difusorabiblica.com): the publisher of this translation
- [Franciscanos Capuchinhos](https://www.capuchinhos.org): the Portuguese Capuchin province
